tenures.source: /promotions/uiwf/archive/johnny-legend-uiwf-application-2011-02-03.html (his application to the UiWF, taken on the day it was sent)
tenures.note: Applies as "The Living Legend" Johnny Legend, the billing the fWo's own write-ups give him; the application names the fWO and High Octane Wrestling as the feds whose record books show him undefeated. The fWo's own 8 July 2009 card has One Eye call him one trained by Matt Fury, the trainer this application names.

caption: "The Living Legend" Johnny Legend won the American Wrestling Alliance's first match in October 2007, fought One Eye across the fWo's 2009 season to a Last Man Standing loss at Legends IV, and in 2011 told the UiWF he was trained by Matt "The Hitman" Fury.

identity.note: Kept apart from the eWo's Johnny Legend of 2004 (johnny-legend-ewo, the first eWo Primetime Champion, /promotions/ewo/archive/about.html) for now, but not on the name alone: in his first fWo blog of 12 April 2009 (/promotions/fwo-fans-1998/rp/the-legendary-blog-1-2009-04-12.html) "The Living Legend" says anyone who does not know him has 'been under a rock since 2004' and counts 'five years making an impact in the wrestling world', and the 2011 UiWF application (/promotions/uiwf/archive/johnny-legend-uiwf-application-2011-02-03.html) says he has 'had matches with a few actual Legends, and has won' though he 'has never won a major singles title'. No page names the eWo for him, and the eWo's own page tells nothing of its Johnny Legend beyond naming him among its stars and the Bound for Glory ladder match. Kept apart until the handler's own word, or a document naming both, joins or parts them.

notes: AWA (ewcentral.com), October 2007 (/promotions/awa-ewcentral-2007/archive/gold-and-glory-tour-week-1-2007-10-06.html): wins the promotion's first match. fWo, April to October 2009: introduces himself in a blog of 12 April 2009 (/promotions/fwo-fans-1998/rp/the-legendary-blog-1-2009-04-12.html) as "The Living Legend", 'under a rock since 2004' for anyone who has not heard of him; debuts on 15 April 2009 (/promotions/fwo-fans-1998/archive/fwo-fans-1998-reaction-2009-04-15.html) and beats Xander Scott with a small package after his Legendary Leap goes wrong; enters Meltdown on 28 June 2009 with Brittney Chambers as his partner. Then a season-long feud with One Eye, the masked fighter who calls him 'one trained by Matt Fury' (8 July 2009, a no contest): a backstage chair attack (22 July), a slot-machine brawl ending in a Legendary Leap from the FWO-Tron (29 July), a disqualification for a baseball bat (5 August), an airport brawl (19 August), and three forced partnerships with One Eye, all lost (29 August, 5 and 12 September), until the Last Man Standing match at Legends IV on 27 September 2009 (/promotions/fwo-fans-1998/archive/fwo-fans-1998-legends-iv-2009-09-27.html), the loser to leave the fWo, fought from a shopping cart of weapons out to the loading dock. One Eye wins it; his father then swings a katana at Legend, and the card of 10 October 2009 reports him believed carried off to Japan. UiWF, February 2011 (/promotions/uiwf/archive/johnny-legend-uiwf-application-2011-02-03.html): applies as "The Living Legend" Johnny Legend, a high flier who knows martial arts and has never won a major singles title; he says he was trained by Matt "The Hitman" Fury and is undefeated in the record books of High Octane Wrestling and the fWO, having wrestled only two matches in each (the fWo's own write-ups hold nine fWo matches for him, some of them losses: the two records disagree and both stand). The fed's staff take him on the same day.
